model: Synthetic signed single-phase wheel/drivetrain amplitudes; no fitted vehicle model
duplicate: Exact copy of baseline observation, including its error
transfer_assumptions: Wheel gain is exactly 1, with a common phase convention across all conditions.
The separating readout has real drivetrain leakage lambda in [1/5,3/10].
The held-out readout has exactly half that SAME leakage, lambda/2.
Sources and transfer paths are unchanged by the trial mass except for the known wheel offset.
Source amplitudes are unchanged across measurement conditions.
All errors satisfy the stated deterministic bounds; no independent-noise assumption is used.
A correction c changes w to w+c and leaves d and transfer parameters unchanged.
interpretation: Changing relative frequencies and demodulation can separate sources; the stated leakage bounds and their cross-condition relation are assumptions, not derived from a vehicle or filter implementation.
scope: Static scalar attribution and correction acceptance only. No quadrature/full imbalance norm, spin transient, actuator safety, vehicle validation, or Lean proof.
